review_candidates.title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: At least 5 years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure or cybersecurity, with substantial hands-on AWS security experience. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Do you have the technical expertise to identify risks, strengthen configurations and protect critical cloud infrastructure? At Boutiqaat , we're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to help secure, optimize and strengthen our cloud environments, with a primary focus on AWS and hands-on experience in Azure. Collaborate & Empower: Work closely with Infrastructure, Development and Security Operations teams to drive secure cloud adoption and share technical expertise. At least 5 years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure or cybersecurity, with substantial hands-on AWS security experience. Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
